notes: §1985:VI.6.12.3 SR1: "Language-name-1 is specified by the implementor." WiseOwl does not provide the ENTER statement: §1985:I.1.5.2.5.5 "An implementation of Standard COBOL may include the ENTER statement or not, at the option of the implementor", and docs/conformance/3.7.1 records the decision. StatementBinder#BindEnter refuses every ENTER at 85 with COBOL7240 (kb/Work PB5308), the other-language sentence and ENTER COBOL alike; the witness is that refusal. Recorder's correction (records-read6, 2026-11-14): the row read CONFORMS on the reading that an ENTER is provided with no language, which the compiler's own refusal of ENTER COBOL. contradicts; kb/Work PB5373 class 3 decides that a rule whose subject is an element WiseOwl declines by a documented decision is DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT witnessed by the element's named diagnostic, and records the ENTER rows "with 1985-SR-VI.6.12.3-1 and -3 when PB5308 lands" (it has). The read-6 refuter of the ENTER general rules (op-20261114/out-read6/rd-03-refute.json) found this CONFORMS wrong in category for -3 and the same for -1 under one consistent reading of §1985:I.1.5.2.5.5. Previous verdict: CONFORMS.
